content:
The Black Friday season just keeps on giving for gamers this season, which happens to sync up with the launch week of GTA 6 — of which you can now grab a brand new spare Xbox controller to play for just a penny under £40.

At the time of writing, Amazon has dropped its biggest Black Friday controller deals for the standard carbon black and robot white Xbox controllers: now £39.99 at Amazon UK with a 33% discount off their usual £59.99 sticker price.

Save A Bunch on Xbox Controllers and Accessories This Black Friday

For added context, this is the lowest price Xbox controllers have been on the site this entire year — and hasn’t been seen at this level since briefly during the end of the summer before shooting back up in October.

To be clear, these controllers aren’t just for the Xbox Series X|S either; these work with the older Xbox One console, PC (like Steam games or Xbox games on its PC app), smart TVs via Xbox Cloud Gaming, and mobile phones.

On the other hand, if you fancy an alternative colour to jazz up your console gaming setup for Grand Theft Auto 6, Amazon has some even better controller styles on sale, as well — just a bit more expensive than the standard black and white controllers.

For instance, the vivid-looking velocity green and deep pink colour Xbox controllers are on offer for £42.49 (35% off the standard £64.99). Alternatively, the very Vice City-appropriate heart breaker-colour controller is only £41.99, granting you its fun mix of blue, neon pink, and purple colour splashes for 44% off the normally £74.99 price.

The best benefit to having a spare controller for a massive game like Grand Theft Auto VI is that you can simply swap controllers whilst you recharge the main gamepad. Although, unlike the PS5 controllers that are on sale for as low as £42.99, as well, this doesn’t usually apply to Xbox, as many of you will remember that standard Xbox controllers still run on disposable batteries.

Thankfully, you can quickly fix that with Venom’s Charging Dock with Rechargeable Battery Pack for £9.26 — also on sale at Amazon, where you can also buy extra rechargeable batteries, a bigger dock for two controllers, or an alternative white dock if that’s more suited to your particular setup.
